longest_story.title: Home Coming
longest_story.colors: Brian Haberlin; Andy Troy; Ian Hannin
longest_story.characters: Spawn [also as Al Simmons]; Wanda Fitzgerald; Cyan Fitzgerald; Terry Fitzgerald; Mom
longest_story.synopsis: With the world finally restored, Al prepares to reunite with Wanda and take his old life back. Before he does, however, Mom allows him to watch a fight between Wanda and Terry where she reveals a secret that Al's memory has long suppressed. Before Al left on the mission where he died and became Spawn, he had punched Wanda in the stomach and aborted their unborn baby as children were not part of his current plans. Horrified by this revelation, Al transforms back into Spawn and returns to the alley where it all began.

longest_story.title: The Voice-Hearers Part One: Skin Deep
longest_story.characters: Spawn; Twitch Williams; Sam Burke (flashback)
longest_story.synopsis: Twitch visits Spawn in the alley where he has once again taken up residence. Spawn explains to him what happened during the white light event that ended Armageddon. The world was destroyed but Spawn brought it back again, only this time without God and the Devil. They have been banished and the supernatural will no longer plague mankind. Twitch tells Spawn that at first things were calm and peaceful but now the police are seeing cases of ordinary people committing crimes of unmatched brutality.

longest_story.title: The Voice-Hearers Part Two: The Peanut Butter Lady
longest_story.characters: Spawn; Jason Wynn; Twitch Williams; Sam Burke; Agent Wolf; Agent Hare; Violator (cameo)
longest_story.synopsis: Twitch continues to tell Spawn about a certain apartment building where ordinary people are doing horrible things to themselves and each other. Spawn at first refuses to help but then decides to investigate once he learns Violator may be involved.

longest_story.title: The Voice-Hearers Part Three: Laughter In the Dark
longest_story.characters: Spawn; Jason Wynn; Twitch Williams; Sam Burke; Violator; Mammon (cameo)
longest_story.synopsis: Spawn learns that Violator crossed over into the new demon-free world he created after the white light event and has been inspiring people in an apartment building to destroy themselves and those they love. Spawn catches up with the clown and sends him back to Hell.

longest_story.first_line: New Orleans. The French Quarter. Some time after the end of the world.
longest_story.characters: Nyx; Suzanne LeFevre; Jacques Lenoir (death of); Al Simmons [Spawn]; Zera; Mammon
longest_story.synopsis: This issue opens with a girl named Nyx being chased by some evil looking dogs, and boy, do they look hungry. She enters a voodoo shop to get away from the dogs. The voodoo queen insists for Nyx not to keep her appointment with a charlatan who says he can give her her magic back. It is a trap being set up by Mammon, to bring Zera, Queen of the Seraphim, back to the living by having Nyx become possessed by Zera. The Voodoo queen has called upon Al Simmons to save the day. [review by Martijn Form]

longest_story.title: A Tale of Three Brothers Part One: Hellhouse
longest_story.characters: Abbadon; Nyx; Spawn [Al Simmons]; Zabraxas; Ada Summers; Reverend Richard Simmons (Spawn's brother; name and identity revealed next issue); Principal Weinstock (as apparition); Wanda Simmons (as apparition)
longest_story.synopsis: Ab and Zab are bored with regular mayhem and killing but find a leaflet for Hell House stuck in the pages of a porn magazine. They travel there only to find that it is closed down as the recent Armageddon the world experienced has caused people to stop believing in Heaven or Hell. They convince the pastor who runs the place that they are the perfect ones to drum up new business. They do so by opening a gateway to a corner of Hell itself. Spawn arrives to oppose them but opens one of the doors and finds himself confronted by his dead wife.
longest_story.notes: Hell Houses are real events, usually put on by evangelical Christian churches during the Halloween season which combine elements of a haunted house with a religious message. Primarily aimed at youth, they show various "sinful" activities and the horrific consequences of these sins. The advertisement for the Hell House in the comic lists "sodomites with their minds and bodies rotting from AIDS, murder, abortions, drunkards and drug fiends" as part of the bill which, although extreme in its language, are factually based as these are common thematic elements of Hell House events.

longest_story.title: A Tale of Three Brothers Part Two: Rememberance
longest_story.characters: Nyx; Spawn [Al Simmons]; Abbadon; Zabraxas; Sin-Eaters (one as Wanda Simmons); Pastor Richard Simmons (Al Simmons' brother)
longest_story.synopsis: Nyx enters the Hell House which has been turned into an actual doorway to Hell and is immediately confronted by Spawn who accuses her of wrecking his life. She uses her magic to reveal that this "Spawn" is really a Sin-Eater in disguise and she shows the real Spawn that his "wife" is a Sin-Eater as well. The two track down the pastor who runs Hell House and is experiencing a personal hell of his own. Spawn is taken aback as he recognizes the pastor as his brother Richard and the Sin-Eater who is confronting him is a boy all three of the Simmons' brothers supposedly murdered years before.
